answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 3 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The jade debit happens at intake, saffron totals the burned amount, and juniper anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 200 pays that 138 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
